roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full administrative access across all modules, approvals, and user management

roles.name: Purchase Manager
roles.description: Manages sourcing, reviews RFQs, approves supplier purchase orders up to ₹10,00,000

roles.name: Purchase User
roles.description: Creates requirements, drafts vendor RFQs, compares quotes and tracks order delivery

roles.name: Approval User
roles.description: Senior reviewer authorized to approve high-value procurement requests and vendor quotes

roles.name: Accounts User
roles.description: Oversees financial settlements, vendor payments, GST invoices and proforma billing

roles.name: Store User
roles.description: Handles goods receiving, dispatch LR verification, and physical warehouse inventory

roles.name: Management / Viewer
roles.description: Executive read-only visibility into procurement KPIs, analytics and audit trails

approvals.comments: Approved with commercial margin locked at 14.2%.

products.description: ABB SACE Formula A2C 250 TMF 250-2500 Circuit Breaker (250A, 4-Pole) Ensure precise protection for your equipment with the ABB SACE Formula A2C 250. This 4-pole Molded Case Circuit Breaker (MCCB) is rated at the maximum frame capacity of 250A and features a highly reliable thermomagnetic release (TMF) for precise overload and short-circuit protection, with a fixed magnetic trip at 2500A. Built on the robust A2C 250 frame, this breaker provides a high breaking capacity with a 25 kA service breaking capacity (Ics) at 240 V AC and 12.5 kA at 380 V AC. It offers excellent versatility with a rated operational voltage of up to 550V AC and 250V DC, making it an ideal choice for protecting main feeders, motors, and distribution panels where high inrush currents and higher fault levels are expected. Engineered for longevity, it delivers a mechanical lifespan of 10,000 cycles and an electrical lifespan of 4,000 cycles. With front bolt terminals, installation is secure, straightforward, and space-efficient. The 4-pole configuration ensures full protection for both phase and neutral lines. With a low power loss of 16 W per pole, it is also highly energy-efficient.

products.description: The ABB 1SYK100001A1004 IIS106BL BL 6A Bell Push Switch with Indicator is a premium modular electrical accessory from the ABB IVIE series, designed to provide convenient and reliable doorbell operation in residential, commercial and institutional buildings. Featuring an attractive white finish, a compact single-module design and an integrated indicator, this bell push switch offers both functionality and a modern appearance. Designed for 240V AC electrical installations with a rated current of 6A, the switch features a momentary push-button mechanism that activates the connected bell circuit when pressed. Its integrated indicator provides a convenient visual reference, making the switch suitable for indoor doorbell and signalling applications. The product is designed for installation with compatible ABB IVIE modular switch plates and accessories. Its compact design makes it a practical choice for residential apartments, offices, hotels, commercial buildings, institutional facilities and modern electrical installations.

This 8-pole, 8-module enclosure is designed to accommodate compatible modular circuit breakers and electrical protection devices for residential, commercial, and industrial electrical installations. The ABB SEN 8P enclosure provides an organized and practical solution for housing electrical distribution components. Its compact design allows installation of compatible modular devices in a dedicated enclosure, making it suitable for applications where organized wiring, component accessibility, and efficient space utilization are important.

products.description: The ABB 1SYK100001A1160 IIM1USBC PL 2A Modular USB Charger is a modern electrical wiring accessory from ABB's IVIE series, designed to provide convenient USB charging access in residential, commercial and hospitality electrical installations. Featuring an elegant silver finish and compact single-module design, this charger offers a practical and space-saving solution for modern modular switchboards. With a rated USB output current of 2 Amps, the ABB IVIE USB Charger provides a dedicated charging connection for compatible smartphones, electronic accessories and other USB-powered devices. Its integrated charging arrangement reduces the need for a separate plug-in USB power adapter when used with suitable charging cables and devices. The compact one-module construction allows integration with compatible ABB IVIE modular switch plates and mounting accessories. Its silver finish complements contemporary interiors and coordinates with other ABB IVIE silver-finish switches, sockets and electrical accessories.

The ABB 1SYK100001A1004 IIS106BL BL 6A Bell Push Switch with Indicator is a premium modular electrical accessory from the ABB IVIE series, designed to provide convenient and reliable doorbell operation in residential, commercial and institutional buildings. Featuring an attractive white finish, a compact single-module design and an integrated indicator, this bell push switch offers both functionality and a modern appearance. Designed for 240V AC electrical installations with a rated current of 6A, the switch features a momentary push-button mechanism that activates the connected bell circuit when pressed. Its integrated indicator provides a convenient visual reference, making the switch suitable for indoor doorbell and signalling applications. The product is designed for installation with compatible ABB IVIE modular switch plates and accessories. Its compact design makes it a practical choice for residential apartments, offices, hotels, commercial buildings, institutional facilities and modern electrical installations.

ABB SEN 8P Electrical Distribution Enclosure, part number 1SYN869004R0029, from the ABB Classic Series. This 8-pole, 8-module enclosure is designed to accommodate compatible modular circuit breakers and electrical protection devices for residential, commercial, and industrial electrical installations. The ABB SEN 8P enclosure provides an organized and practical solution for housing electrical distribution components. Its compact design allows installation of compatible modular devices in a dedicated enclosure, making it suitable for applications where organized wiring, component accessibility, and efficient space utilization are important.

The ABB 1SYK100001A1204 is a high-quality 6A modular bell push switch with a built-in indicator from the ABB IVIE range of electrical switches and wiring accessories. Designed for doorbell and momentary signalling applications, this switch features an elegant anthracite grey painted finish that complements modern residential, commercial and office interiors. Rated at 6A and 240V AC, this single-module bell push switch operates through a momentary push mechanism. When pressed, it activates a compatible doorbell or signaling circuit and automatically returns to its original position when released. The integrated indicator provides convenient visual identification, while its compact design allows neat installation in compatible ABB IVIE modular switch plates.

The ABB 1SYK100001A1205 is a premium-quality 6A Mega Bell Push Switch with Indicator from the ABB IVIE range of modular switches and electrical wiring accessories. Designed for doorbell operation and momentary signalling applications, this switch features an elegant anthracite grey finish that complements modern residential, commercial and office interiors. Rated at 6A and 240V AC, this 2-module bell push switch operates through a momentary mechanism that activates a compatible doorbell or signaling device when pressed and returns to its original position when released. Its built-in indicator provides convenient visual identification, while the wider mega-switch design offers a larger operating surface than a standard single-module bell push switch.

The ABB 1SYK100001A1228 is a high-quality 6A 3-pin modular electrical socket from the ABB IVIE range of switches and wiring accessories. Designed for convenient power connections in residential and commercial interiors, this socket features an elegant anthracite grey finish that complements modern electrical switchboards and modular fittings.

The ABB 1SYK100001A1223 is a high-quality 6/16A modular electrical socket from the ABB IVIE range of switches and wiring accessories. Designed to accommodate compatible 6A and 16A electrical plugs, this socket features an elegant anthracite grey painted finish that complements modern residential, commercial and office interiors. Rated for 240V AC applications, this 2-module socket provides a convenient power connection point for compatible household and commercial electrical equipment. Its combination socket design offers flexibility for different plug types, subject to the circuit's electrical rating and appropriate wiring.
